title: Superhuman footer
description: A deep maroon footer: the lockup and a 25px tagline at the left, four link columns (bold heading, regular links at 40px steps, the last column with small icons) at the right, and underneath a giant ghost wordmark in capitals that spans the full width at 5 % white. On phones the columns stack in one list.
notes: deep surface: uses the sidebar colours (maroon in the Superhuman theme)
the ghost wordmark scales with the container width (container query units); about nine letters fill the width
